verdict.rationale: Kimi itself ships built-in agents that take delegated work. The homepage invites users to "做个 Agent 任务" (do an Agent task), the help center documents an agent mode, Agent clusters and scheduled tasks, and Kimi Code's Agent reads code, edits files, runs commands and verifies results on its own. Community reports mention using the Kimi CLI and its planning help, though one user saw the model break code after heavy grepping; this tempers quality but does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the consumer agent mode's limits (help-center entries are only titles), strong independent hands-on confirmation that delegated tasks complete reliably.
